verdict.rationale: Ollama's marketing docs explicitly claim 'dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when you are running several agents at once' (referring to Ollama Cloud), but this is a single unverified vendor claim with no technical detail, benchmarks, or independent confirmation of concurrent-session throughput guarantees. Community evidence discusses local performance variability and CPU/GPU fallback issues but never tests or corroborates this specific concurrency-reservation claim.
